payload.title: The shared guard layer fails open for unclassified operations: RolesGuard admits any authenticated caller when a handler declares no @Roles and TenantPermissionGuard passes without a decorator, and only farm-service has a fail-closed operation classification, so unannotated hr and sensor operations answer every tenant member
evidence: apps/hr-service/src/app.module.ts:396-397 (RolesGuard is an hr APP_GUARD; sensor registers it the same way at app.module.ts:523-524)
apps/sensor-service/src/edge-device/edge-device.resolver.ts:87 (edgeDevice query declares no @Roles, nor does its class)
apps/farm-service/src/app.module.ts:576-577 (farm's PermissionMatrixGuard is the only fail-closed classification)
payload.rule_violated: Plan PKG-05 goal (unclassified operations fail closed) and the repo hierarchy impossible > automatic > detectable
